title: fleet-acl.json — per agent_type filesystem/shell allowlist enforced by the PreToolUse hook (prototype: docs/agent-fleet-v4/prototypes/acl-hook.js)

defaults.description: applied to any agent_type not listed (fail-closed: empty lists)

agents.description: key = agent_type as delivered in hook stdin

read_allow.description: repo-relative directory roots; Read/Grep/Glob scope must resolve inside one of them (canonicalised via realpath, case-insensitive). Grep/Glob without `path` resolve to cwd ⇒ denied unless cwd is allowed. Placeholders: {story}, {module}, {component}

write_allow.description: roots for Write/Edit; empty = read-only agent

shell.description: exact command prefixes allowed for Bash/PowerShell; absent = no shell tool at all (preferred for blind agents)
